article.body:
Rebbe's farbrengens
This niggun was first introduced by the Rebbe at a Tzivos Hashem rally held on Lag B'omer תשמ״ב‎ (1982). The Rebbe requested that in connection with "tefilla," the words” " should be sung with a niggun, and it "should become ours." This niggun was also later sung at the conclusion of many other rallies

May it be Your will

Hashem, our G-d

of the shofar will get everyone’s attention...”

“...And the clapping and singing will never end!” Shneur adds.

“It’ll be soon!” Mommy Shir shuts off the light and gives her tired boys goodnight kisses. “That’s when we’ll fulfill Hashem's mitzvos in a complete way, with lebedikeit and simcha.”

“I can’t wait!” says Tzvi, smiling as he falls asleep.
